snippet.title: Working Title: Ratocalypse | Is The Movement Too Fast? (Motion Sickness Check!)
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! 

I'm working on a classic "Boomer Shooter" and trying to capture that feeling of pure, fast-paced retro action. However, I need to make sure the speed and camera work don't cause motion sickness for players. 

In this short clip, you'll see the current player movement speed, the Head Bob effect, and the Weapon Sway.

Help Me Tune The Movement!

Your feedback is critical. If you are sensitive to motion sickness, please let me know:

    Speed: Does the movement feel too fast or chaotic when rapidly changing direction?

    Camera: Is the Head Bob (the vertical/horizontal camera movement while walking) too intense?

    Overall Feel: Does the combination of speed and camera motion cause you any discomfort, headache, or nausea?

I want the game to be fast, but I absolutely need to make sure I'm not making people sick!
